label: Set symbol
description: Change the active chart symbol and request a fresh candle snapshot.
validationRules: symbol must be supported by the active market data provider

label: Set timeframe
validationRules: timeframe must be one of the supported intervals

label: Set viewport
description: Pan, zoom, or reset the visible candle range without changing market data.
validationRules: visibleCount and rightOffset are clamped to safe numeric bounds

label: Layer visibility
description: Show or hide chart layers such as MA lines or volume.
validationRules: layer must exist and visible must be boolean

label: Drawing annotations
description: Add, update, select, or remove editable analysis drawings anchored to chart data coordinates.
validationRules: drawing anchors must use timestamp/price/pane/symbol data coordinates
applied drawings become editable chart objects

label: Proposal preview
description: Show, hide, apply, or clear the single pending LLM drawing/comparison preview.
validationRules: new LLM preview replaces the previous pending preview
apply preview creates one grouped chart history entry

label: Comparison overlay
description: Compare another symbol or ETF on the active chart without distorting the main price scale.
validationRules: comparison uses percent scale by default
comparison line must not mutate main price scale
comparison data failure must not break main candle rendering

label: Measurement
description: Measure price change, percent change, and duration between two chart anchors.
validationRules: measurement displays price, percent, and time delta
